items.t: Takata airbag inflator recall
items.job: Replace airbag module with recall-remedy inflator
items.note: Free under the Takata recall. Check your VIN with Mazda or NHTSA first. Never install a used airbag from an unknown car.

items.t: Rusted front crossmember (recall)
items.job: Replace front crossmember (subframe) and align
items.note: Covered by Mazda's recall in salt-belt states; check your VIN. Mild cases only need rust treatment and a brace.

items.t: Dashboard top turns soft and sticky
items.job: Replace dashboard upper panel (crash pad)
items.note: Mazda's 10-year extension has ended for most cars, but ask a dealer about goodwill. A fitted dash cover is a cheap fix.

items.t: Spider webs block fuel tank vent (recall)
items.job: Clean canister vent line, replace check valve, update PCM
items.note: Free under Mazda's recall; check your VIN. If the fuel tank was deformed or cracked, it must be replaced and costs much more.

items.t: Rear parking brake sticks from corrosion (recall)
items.job: Replace rear parking brake actuators or calipers (pair)
items.note: Free under Mazda's parking brake recall; check your VIN. Price is for both rear wheels.

items.t: Engine may stall while driving (recall)
items.job: Update engine computer (PCM) software
items.note: Free software update under Mazda recall 3719F. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Fuel pump in the tank can fail (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump module
items.note: Free under recall 21V-875. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tire pressure warning may miss a slow leak in all four tires (recall)
items.job: Reprogram tire pressure monitoring software
items.note: Free under recall 14V-675. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Door latch screws can work loose (recall)
items.job: Apply thread locker and retorque door latch screws
items.note: Free under recall 13V-425. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Thermostat sticks open (code P0126)
items.job: Replace thermostat and top up coolant

items.t: Cylinder deactivation fault (code P3400)
items.job: Replace oil control valve for cylinder deactivation
items.note: More work is needed if debris has reached other valve train parts.

items.t: Fuel sender unit can leak at the top of the tank (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reseal or replace the fuel tank top
items.note: Free under recall 03V-531. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fog light socket can drop into the bumper (recall)
items.job: Install fog light socket retaining spring
items.note: Free under recall 03V-206. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake fluid warning light may not come on (recall)
items.job: Replace brake fluid level sensor assembly
items.note: Covered by recall 03V-207; ask the dealer whether remedy parts are available.

items.t: Rear seat belt retractor may not lock (recall)
items.job: Replace rear seat belt retractor
items.note: Free under recall 04V-582. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel tank coating damage can lead to rust and leaks (recall)
items.job: Inspect fuel tank coating, replace tank if corroded
items.note: Free under recall 08V-412. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Alternator belt can slip in heavy rain and trigger a charging warning (recall)
items.job: Reprogram the powertrain control module
items.note: Free under recall 14V-173. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Overfilling the tank can push fuel into the charcoal canister (recall)
items.job: Install fuel shut-off valve adapter and inspect canister
items.note: Free under recall 14V-170. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Weld debris can damage passenger seat airbag wiring (recall)
items.job: Protect occupant sensor wiring, repair if damaged
items.note: Free under recall 17V-546. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Turn signals may not switch off on their own (recall)
items.job: Replace the combination switch
items.note: Free under recall 16V-753. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Navigation card makes the screen restart in cold weather
items.job: Replace the navigation SD card
